get_record.description: Get one record by its number, its DOI or the address of its page: its title, abstract, authors, collaboration, dates, licence and DOI, its files with their sizes, checksums and download links, its file indexes, and the records it was derived from. Works for documentation and news pages too.

lookup_glossary_term.description: Find what a physics or experiment term means in the portal's glossary, e.g. luminosity or AOD: its definition, other spellings, related terms and where to read more. An exact match comes first.

mock_response.summary: Found 2 glossary terms for 'luminosity'; the best match is Luminosity.

terms.definition: The Luminosity (L) indicates the number of events per time per cross section. The ”Integrated Luminosity” is the sum of the luminosity over time, and is typically measured in units of inverse femtobarn.
Barn is a unit of area, used to express cross sections, and is equivalent to $10^{-24}$ cm². The inverse femtobarn ($fb^{-1}$) is the typical unit used for time-integrated Luminosity.

description: Search the datasets, software and documentation that CERN's experiments (CMS, ATLAS, LHCb, ALICE and others) release on the CERN Open Data portal: find records by experiment, type, year, collision energy or file format, read one with its files and download links, count them, look up physics terms, and run a workflow when new ones are published. No account or API key required.

cern_open_data_new_record_trigger.description: Triggers once for each record newly published on the CERN Open Data portal that matches the search text, experiment and record type you choose. The portal publishes in releases, a few times a month. Records already published when you turn it on never trigger it, and one release triggers it for at most the 100 newest matching records.
